programme.desc: The first Bollywood movie made in Hong Kong, it is about an interracial love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy! Faced with many difficulties, can their love prevail?

programme.title: Let It Ghost
programme.desc: Featuring 3 urban ghost stories; a famous actor is haunted after he hit a girl while driving; a taxi driver is being drained dry by a ghost; a ghost child wanders a soon-to-be demolished mall.

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Based on Hong Kong's biggest financial scandal of Ching Yat Yin, who rises from rags to become a billionaire. An ICAC investigator spends 15 years to uncover the truth behind his rapid rise in wealth.

programme.title: Burning Blood
programme.desc: A police betrayal has resulted in the death of a narcotics squad member during the arrest of a drug lord. As other team members uncover the truth, they are torn between loyalty and betrayal.

programme.title: Always Have Always Will
programme.desc: A struggling young man encounters a spirited girl and embarks on an uncertain journey. Together they share joys and sorrows, supporting each other through highs and lows, bringing light to darkness.

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A computer geek who has only been in love once suddenly & surprisingly finds himself getting romantically involved with five different women. Will he find "the-one"?

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai is framed for murder. He takes hostages at the police station and demands talk with a former negotiator. As they engage in a tense battle of wits, their perspectives gradually shift.

programme.title: Trending Topic
programme.desc: Chen Miao's viral article leads to a girl's suicide, prompting her to dig deeper into it and uncovers hidden truths. She joins the battle to advocate for the weak as public opinion shifts.

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: In snowy, surreal Hong Kong, an explosion kills a secret drug lord tycoon. As chaos erupts, his youngest son fights his fugitive brother and warring factions to destroy the family's criminal empire.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later, they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: A pregnant painter hires a confinement nanny, but inexplicable incidents start happening in the house as her one-month confinement begins, threatening her and her baby daughter...

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: After accidentally killing veteran detective Zhan's wife, Wang Tao seeks redemption by assisting Zhan in tracking a serial killer. However, her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends enter a remote mountain, unaware it's a forbidden area. Soon, a boy in a yellow raincoat appears, and eerie events begin to unveil the mountain's ancient curse.

programme.title: The Shadow's Edge
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves steals billions, outsmarting the 'Sky Eye' surveillance system. The Macau police enlist retired expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild the elite squad and hunt down the mastermind.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Li goes undercover to shut down Life Hotel but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As he realizes it serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and his empathy.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.

programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: A trio of thieves kidnaps a baby for ransom, then becomes his unlikely guardian after discovering a deadly plot against the child.

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: A baby hatch that never closes faces moral backlash. Nevertheless, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie, and Nuru remain committed to helping desperate mothers and abandoned newborns.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman takes charge of an operation to arrest the criminals who perform a heist on the train, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead...

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Two sworn brothers become enemies after the girl they love marries one of them. The rivalry is only resolved when the property owner of their shops wants to terminate their tenancies 40 years later.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescues the six major sects & the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues. After several vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the 2 legendary weapons.

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into his own fictional world, where a villain seeks to invade reality, sparking a cross-dimensional clash that will change both worlds.

programme.title: July Rhapsody

programme.title: Burning Stars

programme.title: Marriage with a Liar

programme.title: YUM Investigation

programme.title: Midnight Fly

programme.title: Cold War 2

programme.desc: Three sisters (the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei) attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel Water Margin and starring Ti Lung, this award-winning drama depicts how the courageous Wu Song defeats a tiger, and his bond with Wu Da Lang.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: When an argument gets out of hand between a regular Joe and a wealthy businessman, regular Joe finds himself thrust into the middle of a high stakes wager!

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Brave Archer and His Mate
programme.desc: Fourth in the hugely popular series, the leader of 'Venom', supported by his fellow members and Brave Archer associates, sets out to defeat a mass murderer.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: What starts off as a musical romp turns into something more akin to a Shakespearean tragedy than a beach-babe party. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: When masked killers begin wreaking havoc, three fearless fighters investigate the truth in this magnificent martial arts saga.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: This compelling Shaw Brothers Huangmei Opera depicts the romance of star-crossed lovers the son of a respected government official and a famed prostitute.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: Wong Fei Hung (Gordon Liu) fights for balance in the martial world with the evil Lu school and a northern master in their employ.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Problems ensue after one of two childhood friends who have vowed to become sisters through the exchange of bracelets gets married.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A group of top martial artists try to unveil the truth surrounding a bloody parrot. However, the path ahead is fraught with many challenges.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: This drama centres on the seductive Judy. A woman with a rich husband, she also has two lovers who happen to be brothers!

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: See how Prince 4 tries his hardest to kill the heir apparent, Prince 14 and how, out of frustration, he finally engages an assassin to do the job.

programme.title: Return of the Dead
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang's dark offering depicts the destructive effects of lust as narrated by three psychiatric patients in an asylum.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: In this fascinating saga about a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang, Danny Lee plays a misunderstood refugee, while Ray Lui is a cop battling his own conscience.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: This is a thrilling mix of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, vengeance and edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: When Fang returns from the U.S. to see Rose but starts eyeing her old friend's fiance, Rose shows that she has a thorny side.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: As Wong Hei, a slick assassin, zeroes in on a millionaire named Shek, little does he expect to find himself the target of someone even more dangerous.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: A hothead (Wang Chung) is tempted by the dark side in this coming-of-age tale which centres on c. 1970s lower-class Hong Kong teens.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Essie Lin Chia plays an evil lady warrior who raises the son of a swordsman who scorned her with a blood-curdling ulterior motive in mind.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: A kind Emperor lands himself in big trouble when he begins frequenting the gambling dens to learn what makes his subjects tick. Stars Anthony Lau, Wong Yue.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: A sword-master turned umbrella-maker goes up against a zombie-maker with a 'finger of doom' in this critically acclaimed film.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Lisa Lu stars as the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty in this film that is full of palace intrigues and power games.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Adapted from a book by Ku Lung, this spectacular martial arts showcase features an all-star cast including Ti Lung, Lo Mang, Ai Fei and Lily Li.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang directs this fascinating comedy about three couples and forbidden love across Macau and Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: It's Meng Yuan-wen versus Kuan Feng in this wild and wacky wushu saga about a priceless pole with a spectacular secret.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: An extraordinary youth is determined to reunite with his goddess mother and unravel the mythical Lotus Lamp. Starring Linda Lin Dai.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After they reunite in a casino, two lovers (Lily Ho and Yueh Hua) vow to rid the place of corrupt military leaders and criminal others.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: A swordsman bids to protect a beautiful princess while being stalked by a bunch of assassins. Starring Tung Wei, Kara Hui.

programme.title: The Three Smiles

programme.title: Police Force

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep09

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep11

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep12

programme.title: The Case Book of Arne Ep07
programme.desc: Arne receives a request from the museum to protect an artwork from the 'Phantom Thief, Little Red Riding Hood.' When Arne arrives, he discovers that the artwork has vanished along with...
